items.title: Bobby Hutcherson — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] Gary Burton? [INTERVIEWEE] Gary Burton. They have the mallet way over here, and I do it just like that.

ctx.x: Gary Burton. They have the mallet way over here, and I do it just like that. So I was just – I just put them in my hands, and I said, okay, bam. There it is. Then, at the same time, we were talking last night. I was trying to figure out, how am I going to get the sound of this chord and make it sound big with only four mallets. That’s when I started listening to Horace Silver. I started listening to Horace Silver, and I noticed, Horace Silver’s got the third and the dominant seventh in his left hand, and he plays…
So your music theory came from – that’s like on-the-job training.
